description: ML-detected market anomaly log. Each anomaly includes ts, symbol, score, severity (low/medium/high/critical), features dict (RSI, MA distance, volume ratio, volatility, price changes, liquidation ratio, funding z-score), and natural-language description. Filter by symbol or min severity. 340+ anomalies over 48 days stored. AI agent API for anomaly-driven alerting, pattern mining, and ML-feature provenance.
